changes.old: Onset: a fresh messenger formula at Ezek.36.13 כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה יַ֚עַן אֹמְרִ֣ים לָכֶ֔ם אֹכֶ֥לֶת אָדָ֖ם אתי וּמְשַׁכֶּ֥לֶת גויך הָיִֽית (oshb:Ezek.36.13) opens immediately after the refrain-grade close and samekh mark at oshb:Ezek.36.12, itself licensed as a cutting seam by the addressee change from the 2mp/2ms address of Ezek.36.1-Ezek.36.12 (“you,” the mountains) to the 2fs address (“you,” feminine singular, the land) that opens here — satisfying the cutting rule from this side as well as from the close side ('a seam is assessed from both sides'). MT 36.13 and MT 36.14 are BOTH doubled-note K/Q verses (two Qere each): oshb:Ezek.36.13 carries ketiv 'אתי' / qere 'אָ֑תְּ' (“you,” feminine singular) and ketiv 'גויך' / qere 'גּוֹיַ֖יִךְ' ('your nation' plene); oshb:Ezek.36.14 carries ketiv 'וגויך' / qere 'וְגוֹיַ֖יִךְ' and ketiv 'תכשלי' / qere 'תְשַׁכְּלִי'. All four are split from the K/Q note layer with morpheme separators stripped, the one authorized exception to verse-byte-only quoting. Ezek.36.14 also carries the utterance formula, and it recurs at Ezek.36.15 וְלֹא אַשְׁמִ֨יעַ אֵלַ֤יִךְ עוֹד֙ כְּלִמַּ֣ת הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְחֶרְפַּ֥ת עַמִּ֖ים לֹ֣א תִשְׂאִי ע֑וֹד וגויך לֹא תַכְשִׁ֣לִי ע֔וֹד נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה (oshb:Ezek.36.15) (itself carrying one more K/Q pair on 'your nation') — a doubled internal utterance close. Close: a samekh mark follows Ezek.36.15, ending this sub-unit before the fresh, formally distinct word-event of Ezek.36.16.
